title: Learning Through Energy Refinement and Manifold Projection: A Cooperative EBM-AE Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.13917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) provide a flexible framework for generative modeling by learning an energy landscape that assigns low energy values to realistic samples and higher energies to unlikely observations. Despite their theoretical appeal, training EBMs remains challenging due to the computational cost of Langevin sampling and the difficulty of efficiently exploring the learned data manifold. In this work, we propose a cooperative Energy-Based Model and Autoencoder (EBM-AE) framework that combines energy-based refinement with manifold projection. The proposed approach jointly trains an EBM with a denoising autoencoder and introduces an iterative EBM$\rightarrow$AE$\rightarrow$EBM sampling procedure in which Langevin dynamics and autoencoder projection alternately refine generated samples. translated_title: 通过能量精炼与流形投影进行学习：一种协同的EBM-AE框架
translated_abstract: 能量基模型为生成建模提供了一个灵活的框架，它通过学习一个能量景观，为真实样本分配较低的能量值，为不太可能出现的观测分配较高的能量。尽管具有理论上的吸引力，但由于朗之万采样的计算成本以及高效探索所学数据流形的困难，训练EBM仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种协同的能量基模型与自编码器（EBM-AE）框架，将基于能量的精炼与流形投影相结合。所提出的方法联合训练一个EBM和一个去噪自编码器，并引入了一个迭代的EBM→AE→EBM采样过程，其中朗之万动力学和自编码器投影交替地精炼生成的样本。在该框架中，自编码器充当流形投影算子，对采样轨迹进行正则化，而EBM执行能量……
tldr: 提出了一种能量基模型与去噪自编码器协同训练的框架，通过朗之万动力学与自编码器流形投影交替迭代的采样过程（EBM→AE→EBM）来精炼生成样本。
en_tdlr: A cooperative EBM-AE framework that jointly trains an energy-based model with a denoising autoencoder, iteratively refining generated samples through alternating Langevin dynamics and manifold projection.
